main.description: Get the URLs of the tiles covering a bounding box for a dataset, optionally narrowed to one of its collections. Tiles may hold records of other collections: a caller that asked for a collection keeps the records whose origin starts with urn:atgeo:{dataset}:{collection}:, and a record with no origin matches no collection. There is deliberately no text or name search parameter: the server learns only a coarse area, never what the user is looking for.

dataset.description: The dataset to get tiles for, e.g. 'openstreetmap.org'

collection.description: Narrow to the tilesets carrying this collection of the dataset, e.g. 'way'

bbox.description: Bounding box as xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax in WGS84 decimal degrees

tiles.description: Tile file URLs, in ascending string order

overview.description: True when the area was too large for full-detail tiles and the server answered with coarse overview tiles holding only the most important places; absent means full detail

errors.name: BboxTooLarge
errors.description: The bounding box covers too many tiles

errors.name: BboxTooPrecise
errors.description: One or more bbox coordinates have more than 2 decimal places (finer than 0.01° precision)

errors.name: DatasetNotFound
errors.description: This server serves no tileset carrying the dataset

errors.name: CollectionNotFound
errors.description: This server serves the dataset but no tileset carrying the collection

errors.name: InvalidBbox
errors.description: The bbox parameter must be four comma-separated numbers with ymin < ymax and xmin < xmax, except that a box crossing the antimeridian has xmin > 0 > xmax
